title: Non-uniqueness of continuous trace-scaling flows on certain full factors
summary: We show that if M is a full II_infinity factor such that the fundamental group of a finite corner is R and Out(M) is a locally compact second countable group, then M admits either a unique continuous trace scaling flow or a continuum of pairwise distinct ones, up to cocycle conjugacy. Equivalently, there is either a unique III_1 factor or a continuum of pairwise non-isomorphic III_1 factors with continuous core M.
